notes.title: Hotfix V1.09
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Additions
[olist]
 Added option in menu to toggle "Time Trial Mode"
[/olist]

Note: While time trial mode is active, you will not continue to the next level, instead, completing a level will instead instantly restart the level. This should make trying to beat your best score on a specific level much more seamless. This option can be toggled in the options menu, or by pressing Q while in game.

This is just an inital update and will be tweaked and updated based on the communities feedback


Potential Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed crash relating to ghost when restarting a level
[/olist]

Note: This is being flagged as a "potential fix" as I've been unable to replicate the issue myself before or after the patch but I believe this is fixed now.

Thanks again for all the feedback and bug reports.

Cheers,
-
Marty

notes.title: Hotfix 1.08
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed issue where credits and the bonus level were displaying as "locked" after being unlocked
 Fixed issue where time was not displaying correctly against "credits" and the new bonus level
 Fixed issue where credits time was displaying the time for "Nothing" level
 Fixed issue where menu music volume wasn't be reduced when turning down music volume
[/olist]

Cheers,
-
Marty

notes.title: Hotfix 1.07
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Fixes:
[olist]
 Small fix for level select menu where double pressing could happen
[/olist]

Additions
[olist]
 1 New level unlocked by reaching the credits
 1 New leaderboard for the new level
 1 New music track to accompany your journey on this new level
[/olist]

Notes
The new level is considered a bonus level, and will not count towards your total run time
Crash reports have stopped as of right now, but if you do run into any issues please reach out and I'll get them fixed up asap.

Thanks again to everyone who is playing the game, there is more to come!

Cheers,
-
Marty

notes.title: Hotfix 1.06
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Fixes:
[olist]
 Fixed issue where players couldn't select sound volume with a joystick
 Fixed issue where an achievement could be unlocked before completing all tasks
 Fixed issue where total run time would not be accurate (this did not affect highscores in any way)
 Fixed issue where one particular leaderboard wasn't loading correctly
[/olist]

Crashes:
Developer Notes: this is being flagged as potential fixes as I haven't been able to replicate them
[olist]
 Potential fix for steam Async crash
 Potential fix for crash relating to replay files
 Potential fix for crash related to particle system
[/olist]

Additions
[olist]
 Volume adjuster in options menu now changed to music volume
 Added new FX volume adjuster so players can switch off music or sound effects individually
 Minor update to credits
[/olist]

Thanks to everyone who has reported bugs, crashes, or requests for changes. I will continue hotfixing any issues that arise so please keep reporting them. Once the game is in a good state I will start to add additional features.

Cheers,
-
Marty
